C1501.title: Feasibility of Semi-Selfish Mining Attacks Under Undetected Conditions
C1501.summary: A 2021 study evaluates whether semi-selfish mining can remain undetected and uses backward deduction to design strategies whose observable fork rate resembles normal mining. Simulations show that large pools do not necessarily gain excess rewards. Small pools may profit in theory, but their probability of implementing the strategy successfully without detection is very low, leading the paper to conclude that covert sponsorship is impractical.

references.title: Is semi‐selfish mining available without being detected?
